corrected_content.problem:
![](images/e2/e2fe61de100b4a469e4d79dc67869dd68936a0bf396757c4d08fb4d6cade6bda.png)

The region $D$ is the circle shown above. What is $$
\displaystyle ∬_(D)xy^{2}dA
$$ expressed in polar coordinates?
corrected_content.worked_solution:
The image is the full disk of radius $\sqrt5$. With $x=r\cos\theta$, $y=r\sin\theta$ and $dA=r\,dr\,d\theta$, the integrand becomes $r^4\cos\theta\sin^2\theta$. Hence use
$$\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^{\sqrt5}r^4\cos\theta\sin^2\theta\,dr\,d\theta.$$
